question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.Ameliorate
(Supervisor)
options: Improve
Deteriorate
Challenge
Evaluate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Improve

[Word] - Ameliorate

Explanation:
"Ameliorate" means to make something better or improve a situation. The correct synonym is "Improve" because both words convey the idea of enhancing or making progress.
"Ameliorate" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को बेहतर बनाना या स्थिति में सुधार करना। "Improve" सही समानार्थी है क्योंकि दोनों शब्द सुधार या प्रगति का भाव व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Enhance, Better, Upgrade, Refine, Alleviate

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Ameliorate – सुधारना – (To make something better)
Example: "The new policies aim to ameliorate living conditions in rural areas."

Deteriorate – बिगड़ना – (To become worse)
Example: "His health began to deteriorate due to lack of proper care."

Challenge – चुनौती देना – (To test someone's abilities)
Example: "The puzzle will challenge your problem-solving skills."

Evaluate – मूल्यांकन करना – (To assess or judge something)
Example: "The teacher will evaluate the students' performance at the end of the term."

Improve – सुधारना – (To make or become better)
Example: "Regular exercise can improve your overall health."

Conclusion:
"Improve" is the best synonym for "Ameliorate" because both words mean to make something better. The other options either mean the opposite ("Deteriorate") or are unrelated ("Challenge," "Evaluate").

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word Amend.
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2022)
options: Worsen
Impair
Harm
Rectify
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Rectify

Amend - Rectify

Explanation:
"Amend" means to make minor changes to improve or correct something, and "Rectify" also means to correct or make right. Both words imply fixing or improving something.
"Amend" का अर्थ है सुधार करना या ठीक करना, और "Rectify" का अर्थ भी सुधारना या ठीक करना है। दोनों शब्द किसी चीज़ को सही करने का संकेत देते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Correct, Improve, Revise, Adjust, Modify

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Amend – सुधारना – To make minor changes to improve or correct.
Example: "The committee decided to amend the proposal before finalizing it."

Worsen – बिगाड़ना – To make something worse.
Example: "Ignoring the problem will only worsen the situation."

Impair – कमज़ोर करना – To weaken or damage something.
Example: "Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate."

Harm – नुकसान पहुँचाना – To cause injury or damage.
Example: "Pollution can harm the environment."

Rectify – सुधारना – To correct or make right.
Example: "The company took steps to rectify the error in the billing system."

Conclusion:
"Rectify" is the best synonym for "Amend" because both words mean to correct or improve something. The other options (Worsen, Impair, Harm) have negative meanings and do not fit as synonyms.

question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.

Ample
(Constable GD 2021)
options: Limited
Sufficient
Sparse
Scarce
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Sufficient

Ample - Sufficient

Explanation:
"Ample" means enough or more than enough in quantity, and "Sufficient" also means adequate for the purpose. Both words imply that there is enough of something to meet a need.
"Ample" का अर्थ है पर्याप्त या अधिक मात्रा में, और "Sufficient" का अर्थ भी उद्देश्य के लिए पर्याप्त है। दोनों शब्द यह दर्शाते हैं कि किसी चीज़ की आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए पर्याप्त मात्रा है।

Other synonyms Words:
Abundant, Plentiful, Adequate, Copious, Lavish

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Ample – पर्याप्त – More than enough in size or capacity.
Example: "There is ample space in the room for all the guests."

Limited – सीमित – Restricted in size, amount, or extent.
Example: "We have a limited budget for the project."

Sparse – विरल – Thinly dispersed or scattered.
Example: "The vegetation in the desert is sparse."

Scarce – दुर्लभ – Insufficient for the demand.
Example: "Freshwater is scarce in some regions."

Sufficient – पर्याप्त – Enough to meet the needs of a situation.
Example: "The evidence was sufficient to prove his innocence."

Conclusion:
"Sufficient" is the best synonym for "Ample" because both words convey the idea of having enough or more than enough to fulfill a requirement. The other options ("Limited," "Sparse," and "Scarce") imply insufficiency, which is the opposite of "Ample."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Amputate
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Brighten
Energise
Sever
Argue
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Sever

Amputate - Sever

Explanation:
"Amputate" means to cut off a limb or part of the body, usually for medical reasons. "Sever" is the best synonym as it also means to cut off or separate forcefully.
"अंग-विच्छेदन" का अर्थ है शरीर के किसी अंग को काटकर अलग करना, आमतौर पर चिकित्सा कारणों से। "Sever" सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी जबरदस्ती काटकर अलग करना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Detach, Remove, Cut off, Disconnect, Excise

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Amputate – अंग-विच्छेदन – To cut off a limb or part of the body, especially surgically.
Example: "The doctor had to amputate the infected leg to save the patient's life."

Brighten – चमकाना – To make or become more light or cheerful.
Example: "The sunrise will brighten the room with natural light."

Energise – ऊर्जा देना – To give vitality or enthusiasm to someone or something.
Example: "A good breakfast will energise you for the day ahead."

Argue – बहस करना – To exchange opposing views heatedly.
Example: "They often argue about politics."

Sever – काटकर अलग करना – To cut off or separate something forcefully.
Example: "The storm caused a tree branch to sever the power line."

Conclusion:
"Sever" is the best synonym for "amputate" because both words involve cutting off or separating a part, often with force. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Amusement
(CGLE 2021 Tier I)
options: Pleasure
Gloom
Boredom
Despair
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Pleasure

Amusement - Pleasure

Explanation:
"Amusement" refers to a feeling of enjoyment or entertainment, which aligns closely with "pleasure." Both words convey a sense of happiness or delight.
"Amusement" का अर्थ है मनोरंजन या आनंद, जो "pleasure" (खुशी) के समान है। दोनों शब्द सुख या प्रसन्नता की भावना व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Enjoyment, Delight, Entertainment, Fun, Merriment

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Amusement – मनोरंजन – The state of finding something funny or entertaining.
Example: "The children roared with amusement at the clown’s antics."

Gloom – उदासी – A state of darkness or depression.
Example: "The news of the accident cast a gloom over the party."

Boredom – ऊब – The state of feeling uninterested or weary.
Example: "He sighed in boredom during the long lecture."

Despair – निराशा – The complete loss of hope.
Example: "After failing the exam, she was filled with despair."

Pleasure – खुशी – A feeling of happiness or satisfaction.
Example: "It was a pleasure to meet you after so long."

Conclusion:
"Pleasure" is the best synonym for "amusement" as both denote positive feelings of enjoyment. The other options (gloom, boredom, despair) convey negative emotions, making them incorrect.

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Worry

ANXIETY - Worry

Explanation:
"Anxiety" refers to a feeling of unease or nervousness about something with an uncertain outcome, and "worry" is its closest synonym as it also means to feel troubled or concerned.
चिंता किसी अनिश्चित परिणाम के बारे में बेचैनी या घबराहट की भावना को दर्शाती है, और "worry" इसका सबसे करीबी समानार्थी है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी परेशान या चिंतित महसूस करना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Unease, Nervousness, Apprehension, Distress, Fear

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Anxiety – चिंता – (A feeling of worry or unease about something with an uncertain outcome)
Example: "Her anxiety about the exam kept her awake all night."

Faith – विश्वास – (Complete trust or confidence in someone or something)
Example: "He had faith in his team's ability to win the match."

Delight – आनंद – (Great pleasure or joy)
Example: "The children squealed with delight when they saw the ice cream truck."

Calmness – शांति – (The state of being peaceful and free from agitation)
Example: "The calmness of the lake at dawn was breathtaking."

Worry – चिंता – (To feel anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems)
Example: "She couldn't help but worry about her son's safety during the storm."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "worry" is the most appropriate synonym for "anxiety" as both convey a sense of unease or concern. The other options (faith, delight, calmness) represent entirely different emotions.
